title.zh: LG成立机器人业务中心，把Physical AI从研发议题推向交付组织
title.en: LG establishes a robotics business centre to move physical AI toward delivery

summary.zh: LG宣布成立独立的Robotics Business Center，并配套建设数据工厂能力，负责从业务开发到销售和运营的完整链条。值得关注的不是一次组织调整，而是机器人产业开始把训练数据、现场部署、维护服务和商业交付放在同一套组织里。对工程行业，这意味着“机器人进入工地或工厂”不再只是设备采购问题，还会牵涉地面平整度、荷载路径、作业安全、定位基准、充电设施和人机协同边界。结构与土木工程师未来需要理解设备运行工况和维护周期，才能把自动化设备真正纳入建筑与基础设施的全寿命设计。
summary.en: LG has created a dedicated Robotics Business Center, together with data-factory capability, covering business development, sales, and operations. The important signal is not merely an organisational change: robotics is beginning to combine training data, field deployment, maintenance, and commercial delivery in one operating model. For the built environment, robots entering factories or construction sites will involve more than equipment procurement. Floor flatness, load paths, operational safety, positioning references, charging infrastructure, and human-machine boundaries become design inputs. Civil and structural engineers will increasingly need to understand equipment duty cycles and maintenance requirements if automation is to be integrated into buildings and infrastructure over the asset life.

watch.zh: 关注机器人数据工厂是否转化为可量化的安全验证、维护责任和现场验收标准。
watch.en: Watch whether the data-factory model becomes measurable safety validation, maintenance accountability, and site-acceptance criteria.

liveUpdates.reference: LG Electronics announcement on its Robotics Business Center

title.zh: Intel与LËNS Technology合作推进AI时代先进封装，封装设备成为产能瓶颈之一
title.en: Intel and LËNS Technology collaborate on advanced packaging for the AI era

summary.zh: Intel与LËNS Technology宣布合作，目标是提升先进半导体封装设备的自动化、精度和产能。AI芯片竞争正在从单纯的晶体管性能延伸到封装、互连、热管理和良率控制，意味着制造能力本身成为产品路线的一部分。对跨行业工程师而言，先进封装厂房不是普通轻工业建筑：洁净室振动、设备基础、温湿度稳定、极端洁净、工艺气体和维护吊装共同决定产线可用率。结构工程设计应更早参与设备荷载、微振动控制和后续工艺升级，而不是等设备清单冻结后再被动配合。
summary.en: Intel and LËNS Technology announced a collaboration intended to improve the automation, precision, and capacity of advanced semiconductor-packaging equipment. AI-chip competition is moving beyond transistor performance into packaging, interconnects, thermal management, and yield control, making manufacturing capability part of the product roadmap. For engineers working across sectors, an advanced-packaging facility is not an ordinary light-industrial building: cleanroom vibration, equipment foundations, environmental stability, process gases, and maintenance lifting all influence line availability. Structural design needs to engage earlier with equipment loads, micro-vibration control, and future process upgrades instead of waiting for the equipment list to be frozen.

watch.zh: 关注先进封装扩产是否带动旧厂房改造、设备基础加固和洁净室结构性能验证。
watch.en: Watch whether packaging expansion drives brownfield retrofits, equipment-foundation strengthening, and structural verification for cleanrooms.

liveUpdates.reference: Intel and LËNS Technology collaboration announcement

referenceLinks.label: Intel Newsroom: Intel and LËNS Technology

title.zh: 美国Genesis Mission把AI科研基础设施纳入国家级能源与计算计划
title.en: The US Genesis Mission places AI research infrastructure inside a national energy and computing programme

summary.zh: 美国白宫发布Genesis Mission，提出把联邦科研数据、超级计算、实验设施和AI工具连接起来，以加速能源、材料和生物医学研究。它释放出的行业信号是：AI基础设施正在从企业数据中心扩展为由公共科研设施、能源系统和长期数据治理共同支撑的国家级工程。对土木和结构专业，机会不只在机房建设，还在实验设施改造、重型设备基础、极端环境防护、数据中心能源冗余和跨机构资产管理。项目成功与否取决于接口治理和可验证性能，而不是单一模型或单一建筑的先进程度。
summary.en: The White House Genesis Mission proposes connecting federal research data, supercomputing, experimental facilities, and AI tools to accelerate work in energy, materials, and biomedicine. The industry signal is that AI infrastructure is expanding from corporate data centres into national engineering programmes supported by public research facilities, energy systems, and long-term data governance. For civil and structural professionals, the opportunity extends beyond server halls to laboratory retrofits, heavy-equipment foundations, extreme-environment protection, energy redundancy, and cross-agency asset management. Delivery will depend on governed interfaces and verifiable performance, not on the sophistication of one model or one building.

watch.zh: 关注科研设施的算力、能源和实验设备是否形成统一的容量规划与资产接口。
watch.en: Watch whether compute, energy, and laboratory equipment are managed through one capacity plan and asset-interface strategy.

liveUpdates.reference: The White House Genesis Mission announcement

area.zh: 钢结构连接与模块化建造

title.zh: 模块化结构的性能上限，往往由连接细节而不是构件强度决定
title.en: For modular steel structures, connection detailing can govern performance before member strength

insights.evidence: Peer-reviewed study of long-bolted connections in panelized modular houses

summary.zh: 关于板式模块化住宅长螺栓连接的同行评审研究表明，连接板厚度、螺栓布置和螺栓直径会显著改变连接的承载力、破坏模式和转动能力。这个结论对结构工程的启发很直接：模块化建造把制造公差、吊装阶段、现场拼装和最终受力状态压缩到同一个连接节点中，节点的滑移、孔壁承压、板件屈曲和施工可达性可能比构件名义强度更早控制。未来工程师需要把连接设计、装配顺序、可检查性和替换策略一起建模，并用试验或经验证的非线性分析校准关键假设。研究基于特定模块体系和有限元参数分析，不能直接替代项目规范验算。
summary.en: A peer-reviewed study of long-bolted connections in panelized modular housing found that plate thickness, bolt arrangement, and bolt diameter materially affect capacity, failure mode, and rotational behaviour. The engineering implication is direct: modular construction compresses manufacturing tolerance, lifting, site assembly, and the final load path into the same joint. Slip, bearing, plate instability, and inspection access may govern before nominal member strength. Future engineers will need to model connection design together with erection sequence, inspectability, and replacement strategy, using tests or validated nonlinear analysis to calibrate critical assumptions. The study is based on a particular modular system and parametric finite-element work; it does not replace project-specific code verification.

caveat.zh: 连接研究的结果依赖板件、摩擦面、预紧和装配误差；不能把单一试验或模型参数直接外推到所有模块体系。
caveat.en: Connection results depend on plates, faying surfaces, pretension, and erection tolerances; one test or model parameter set cannot be generalised to every modular system.

insights.reference: Elhadary, Bediwy and Elshaer, Advances in Structural Engineering

referenceLinks.label: UAEU: Capacity and failure mode prediction of long-bolted connections

title.zh: 收缩徐变正在从材料附加项变成结构全寿命的接口问题
title.en: Shrinkage and creep are becoming a whole-life interface problem, not a material add-on

insights.evidence: University of Queensland structural engineering research portfolio

summary.zh: 昆士兰大学将混凝土早龄期行为、收缩徐变、低碳高性能混凝土与结构全寿命分析并列为研究方向，反映出时间效应已不再只是材料专业的附加修正。连续梁、组合构件、预应力结构和高层建筑中，收缩徐变会改变内力重分配、长期挠度、预应力损失、裂缝风险以及机电和幕墙接口的变形需求。对未来结构工程师，关键能力是把材料模型的时间参数、施工龄期、约束条件和监测数据带回结构分析，而不是在软件里默认一个固定的长期系数。模型仍受环境、配合比、养护和施工历史影响，现场试验和项目适用性审查不可省略。
summary.en: The University of Queensland places early-age concrete behaviour, shrinkage and creep, low-carbon high-performance concrete, and whole-life analysis within the same structural research portfolio. This reflects a broader shift: time-dependent behaviour is no longer merely a material add-on. In continuous beams, composite members, prestressed structures, and tall buildings, shrinkage and creep alter force redistribution, long-term deflection, prestress loss, cracking risk, and movement demands at façade and services interfaces. For future structural engineers, the important capability is to carry material time parameters, construction age, restraint, and monitoring evidence back into the structural model rather than accepting a default long-term factor. Models remain sensitive to environment, mix, curing, and construction history; testing and project-specific applicability review remain essential.

caveat.zh: 时间效应模型的参数不确定性很大；在重要构件中应说明参数来源、龄期假设和敏感性，而不是只报告一个长期结果。
caveat.en: Time-dependent parameters are uncertain; important designs should state their sources, age assumptions, and sensitivity rather than reporting one long-term result.

insights.reference: University of Queensland structural engineering research portfolio

title.zh: 结构健康监测的职业价值，在于把数据变成可审计的工程判断
title.en: The professional value of structural health monitoring is turning data into auditable engineering judgement

insights.evidence: University of Nebraska-Lincoln structural engineering research programme

summary.zh: 内布拉斯加大学林肯分校把结构性能、结构健康监测、无损检测、大数据分析、风险可靠度和性能化评估放在同一研究版图中。对行业来说，这比“给桥梁装更多传感器”更重要：监测系统只有在基准状态、数据质量、异常判据和工程处置流程都可追溯时，才会改善维护决策。结构工程师未来需要同时理解传感器不确定性、模型更新、损伤识别和规范责任边界，把连续数据转化为检查优先级、限载建议或进一步试验的证据。大学研究平台能够验证方法，但现场传感器漂移、环境影响和样本不足仍会限制自动化结论。
summary.en: The University of Nebraska-Lincoln places structural performance, structural health monitoring, nondestructive testing, big-data analytics, risk and reliability, and performance-based assessment within one research landscape. For practice, this is more important than simply installing more sensors: monitoring improves maintenance only when the baseline state, data quality, anomaly criteria, and engineering response are traceable. Future structural engineers will need to understand sensor uncertainty, model updating, damage identification, and the boundary of professional responsibility, converting continuous data into evidence for inspection priority, load restriction, or further testing. University platforms can validate methods, but sensor drift, environmental effects, and limited samples still constrain automated conclusions in the field.

caveat.zh: 监测数据不能独立替代现场检查和责任工程师判断；异常检测必须有明确的升级路径与人工复核。
caveat.en: Monitoring data cannot independently replace inspection or the responsible engineer's judgement; anomaly detection needs a defined escalation path and human review.

insights.reference: University of Nebraska-Lincoln structural engineering research overview

title.zh: 高强螺栓连接不只是“螺栓够不够”：中国与国际设计如何处理滑移、承压和预紧？
title.en: A high-strength bolted joint is more than bolt count: how Chinese and international design treat slip, bearing, and pretension

text.zh: 钢结构连接的中外差异，首先不是某一个螺栓强度数字，而是连接性能被定义为什么。在中国规范语境中，普通螺栓连接和高强度螺栓连接分别组织抗剪、抗拉、孔壁承压以及摩擦型连接的验算；美国AISC 360和RCSC则明确区分bearing-type与slip-critical连接，并把预紧、摩擦面、安装方法和滑移临界状态纳入设计选择。欧洲Eurocode 3同样将承压型和抗滑移连接分开处理。工程师不能把“高强螺栓”直接等同于“不会滑移”：螺栓等级、预紧力、摩擦面处理、孔型、施工质量和荷载是否反复都会改变控制机制。真正可靠的比较，应先确定功能要求，再确定连接类别和可验证的施工与检查条件。
text.en: The key difference between Chinese and international steel-connection practice is not one bolt-strength number, but what performance the joint is required to provide. Chinese design provisions organise checks for ordinary and high-strength bolted joints, including shear, tension, bearing, and friction-type behaviour. AISC 360 and the RCSC Specification explicitly distinguish bearing-type and slip-critical joints, linking the choice to pretension, faying surfaces, installation method, and the slip limit state. Eurocode 3 likewise separates bearing and slip-resistant connections. A high-strength bolt must not be assumed to be slip-free: bolt grade, pretension, surface treatment, hole type, installation quality, and repeated loading can change the governing mechanism. A reliable comparison starts with the functional requirement, then selects a connection category and construction and inspection controls that can be verified.

label.zh: 先定义功能，再选连接类别
label.en: Define the function before selecting the joint category

text.zh: 如果允许少量滑移后由螺栓和孔壁承压传力，承压型连接的验算逻辑可能适用；如果变形、疲劳或设备定位不允许滑移，就必须按抗滑移目标组织预紧和摩擦面控制。
text.en: If limited slip followed by bolt and hole bearing is acceptable, a bearing-type check may be appropriate. If deformation, fatigue, or equipment alignment does not tolerate slip, pretension and faying-surface control must be organised around a slip-resistant objective.

label.zh: 预紧力不是材料强度的同义词
label.en: Pretension is not a synonym for material strength

text.zh: 高强钢材提高了抗拉和抗剪能力，但抗滑移能力还取决于夹紧力、摩擦系数、表面状态、孔型和安装质量；这些参数应由规范和施工记录共同支持。
text.en: Higher-strength steel increases tensile and shear capacity, but slip resistance also depends on clamping force, friction coefficient, surface condition, hole type, and installation quality; the code and construction records must support those parameters.

label.zh: 重复荷载会改变设计问题
label.en: Repeated loading changes the design problem

text.zh: 风振、机械振动、桥梁交通或设备运行会让滑移、预紧力保持和疲劳相互耦合；静力承载力通过并不代表连接在长期运行中满足性能要求。
text.en: Wind-induced movement, machinery vibration, traffic, or operating equipment can couple slip, pretension retention, and fatigue. Passing a static strength check does not prove satisfactory long-term performance.

takeaway.zh: 设计文件应明确连接是承压型还是抗滑移型，说明预紧、摩擦面、孔型、安装和检查要求，并把连接的实际功能与验算限值对应起来。
takeaway.en: The design record should state whether the joint is bearing-type or slip-resistant, identify pretension, faying-surface, hole, installation, and inspection requirements, and connect the actual joint function to the checked limit state.

title.zh: 参考实例：摩擦型连接的滑移承载力筛查
title.en: Worked reference: a screening check for slip resistance

intro.zh: 以下关系用于解释摩擦型连接的基本力学逻辑，属于派生关系和简化筛查，不是对任一规范条文的逐字转录。正式设计必须采用适用规范规定的预紧力、摩擦面系数、孔型系数、分项系数和施工验收要求。
intro.en: The relations below explain the basic mechanics of a slip-resistant joint. They are derived relations and simplified screens, not verbatim reproductions of a particular code equation. Formal design must use the pretension, faying-surface factor, hole factor, resistance factors, and installation requirements specified by the applicable standard.

label.zh: 单个摩擦界面的可用摩擦力（派生关系）
label.en: Available friction at one faying interface (derived relation)

citation.zh: Derived relation：由库仑摩擦力学得到的概念表达；不是规范编号公式。正式设计应按AISC/RCSC、EN 1993-1-8或GB 50017的具体连接类别和参数取值。
citation.en: Derived relation: a conceptual expression from Coulomb friction mechanics; it is not a numbered code equation. Formal design must follow the joint category and parameters in AISC/RCSC, EN 1993-1-8, or GB 50017.

label.zh: 多界面滑移阻力（派生关系）
label.en: Slip resistance with multiple interfaces (derived relation)

citation.zh: Derived relation：n表示有效摩擦界面数；实际规范还会规定孔型、连接形式、预紧控制和安全格式，不能仅凭螺栓数量放大承载力。
citation.en: Derived relation: n denotes the number of effective faying interfaces. Codes also prescribe hole, joint, pretension, and safety-format provisions; resistance must not be increased by bolt count alone.

label.en: Generic form of a slip check

citation.zh: Code-format citation：Eurocode 3采用设计作用效应不超过设计抗力的格式；EN 1993-1-8中抗滑移连接的具体设计抗力、分项系数和适用条件应按对应条文确定。GB 50017和AISC/RCSC也有各自的安全格式。
citation.en: Code-format citation: Eurocode 3 uses the format in which the design action effect does not exceed the design resistance. The specific resistance, partial factors, and applicability for slip-resistant joints must be taken from the relevant provisions of EN 1993-1-8. GB 50017 and AISC/RCSC use their own safety formats.

note.zh: 例如，若一个连接有两片有效摩擦界面，名义筛查关系可写为Vᵣ≈2μFₚ；但这只是帮助理解“界面数×摩擦×预紧”的关系。实际工程仍需核对螺栓抗拉、孔壁承压、板件净截面、块体破坏、预紧施工和滑移限值。
note.en: For example, with two effective faying interfaces, a nominal screening relation may be written as Vᵣ ≈ 2μFₚ. This only explains the relationship between interfaces, friction, and pretension. The project must still check bolt tension, hole bearing, net section, block shear, pretension installation, and the applicable slip limit.

classroom.references: GB 50017; AISC 360 and RCSC Specification; EN 1993-1-8
